description: This file defines a challenge service module for a chess learning web application. It provides functions to retrieve the daily challenge, list puzzles with optional filters, submit challenge results, and claim rewards, all with fallback implementations for offline or error scenarios.

methods.name: safeRequest
methods.description: A utility function that executes an asynchronous API call and provides a fallback response in case of errors.

methods.name: getDailyChallenge
methods.description: Retrieves the daily chess challenge for the user from the backend API, or provides a mock challenge if the API call fails.

methods.name: listPuzzles
methods.description: Fetches a list of puzzle entries, filtered by optional parameters, with fallback data if API is unavailable.

methods.name: submitChallengeResult
methods.description: Submits the result of a challenge attempt, indicating success and time taken, and returns the backend response or fallback result.

methods.name: claimReward
methods.description: Claims a reward associated with a challenge, returning success confirmation or a mock response on failure.

ctags.name: submitChallengeResult
ctags.pattern: /^export const submitChallengeResult = async ({ id, success, timeMs }) =>$/
